newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RUGBY UNION-FRANCE MAKE THREE CHANGES FOR SECOND TEST.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-FRANCE MAKE THREE CHANGES FOR SECOND TEST.

text.p: French selectors have made three changes to their backline for Saturday's second and final rugby union test against Australia in Brisbane.

Goalkicking centre Christophe Lamaison and fly-half Alain Penaud were recalled after missing the first test through injury, while winger Sebastien Viars was promoted to the starting team after an impressive display as a replacement last weekend.
Richard Dourthe, David Aucagne and David Venditti were all relegated to the reserves' bench after Australia's 29-15 win in last Saturday's first test in Sydney.

France - 15-Jean-Luc Sadourny; 14-Philippe Bernat-Salles, 13-Christophe Lamaison, 12-Thomas Castaignede, 11-Sebastien Viars; 10-Alain Penaud, 9-Philippe Carbonneau; 8-Fabien Pelous, 7-Olivier Magne, 6-Abdel Benazzi (captain), 5-Olivier Merle, 4-Olivier Brouzet, 3-Christian Califano, 2-Marc Dal Maso, 1-Franck Tournaire.
